market_context: U.S. equity futures are modestly higher with S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 futures up around 0.1–0.2%, pointing to a slightly positive open ahead of the release of FOMC minutes later today.[3][11] SPY is trading essentially flat to slightly up in premarket around 767.5, while volatility remains contained with the VIX in the mid-teens and the 10-year yield elevated near 4.7%, suggesting a cautiously risk-on but rates-sensitive environment.[1][3][5] The key scheduled catalysts include U.S. MBA mortgage data, EIA oil inventory reports, a 20-year bond auction, and the 2:00 PM ET release of FOMC minutes, all of which could influence intraday moves especially in the afternoon session.[6][10][11][13]
